        }
    end
end

t1.Kinds = {}

for v3 in t1.Pets do
    table.insert(t1.Kinds, v3)
end

table.sort(t1.Kinds, function(p1, p2) -- line: 428
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    local v4 = t1.Pets[p1]
    local v5 = t1.Pets[p2]

    if v4.Path == v5.Path then
        return v4.Order < v5.Order
    end

    return v4.Path < v5.Path
end)
t1.KindsByPath = {}

for _, v6 in t1.Kinds do
    local Path = t1.Pets[v6].Path

    t1.KindsByPath[Path] = t1.KindsByPath[Path] or {}
    table.insert(t1.KindsByPath[Path], v6)
end

t1.SignRideFrom = 11
t1.SignRideOrder = 5

function t1.GetSignRide(p3) -- line: 453
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    if p3 < t1.SignRideFrom then
        return 1
    end

    return t1.GetBiomeRide(p3)
end

function t1.GetBiomeRide(p4) -- line: 465
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    local v8 = t1.KindsByPath[p4]

    v8 = v8 and t1.Pets[v8[math.min(t1.SignRideOrder, #v8)]]

    if not v8 then
        return 1
    end

    return (math.max(v8.RideSpeed, 1))
end

function t1.GetOpenNow(p1, p2, p3) -- line: 484
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    p1 = p1 or 1
    p3 = p3 or (if p2 then t1.GetOpenSeconds(p2, p1) else 0)

    local n1 = 1

    for v3, v4 in t1.OpenNow do
        if v4.FromBiome then
            if v4.FromBiome <= p1 then
                if not v4.ToSeconds or p3 <= v4.ToSeconds then
                    return v3, v4
                end

                n1 = v3
            end
        else
            if v4.ToBiome and p1 <= v4.ToBiome then
                return v3, v4
            end

            n1 = v3
        end
    end

    return n1, t1.OpenNow[n1]
end

function t1.GetKinds(p4) -- line: 505
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    return (if p4 then t1.PathKinds[p4] else nil) or t1.DefaultKinds
end

function t1.GetOpenSeconds(p5, p6) -- line: 512
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    local v5 = t1.GetLimited(p5)

    if v5 then
        return v5.OpenSeconds
    end

    local v6 = t1.PathOpenSeconds[p6 or 1]
    local v7 = t1.Cages[p5]
    local v8, v9

    if v6 then
        local v10 = v6[p5]

        if v10 then
            v8 = v10
            v9 = true
        elseif v7 then
            local OpenSeconds = v7.OpenSeconds

            if OpenSeconds then
                v8 = OpenSeconds
                v9 = true
            else
                v9 = false
            end
        else
            v9 = false
        end
    elseif v7 then
        local OpenSeconds = v7.OpenSeconds

        if OpenSeconds then
            v8 = OpenSeconds
            v9 = true
        else
            v9 = false
        end
    else
        v9 = false
    end

    if not v9 then
        v8 = 0
    end

    return v8
end

function t1.GetHatchShare(p7, p8) -- line: 531
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    return (math.max((1 - math.clamp(p7, 0, 100) / 100) * (1 - math.clamp(p8, 0, 100) / 100), 1 - t1.HatchMost / 100))
end

local v1 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local v2 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

t1.Kinds = {}

for v3, v4 in t1.Trails do
    table.insert(t1.Kinds, v3)

    if v4.Look then
        v4.Color = v4.Look.Card[1]
        v4.Color2 = v4.Look.Card[2]
    else
        local v5 = PetConfig.Rarities[v4.Rarity]

        v4.Color = v5.Color
        v4.Color2 = v5.Color:Lerp(v2, 0.42)
    end
end

table.sort(t1.Kinds, function(p1, p2) -- line: 320
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    return t1.Trails[p1].Order < t1.Trails[p2].Order
end)

function t1.GetWorld(p3) -- line: 326
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    local v6 = t1.Trails[p3]

    if not (v6 and v6.World) then
        return 1
    end

    return v6.World
end

function t1.GetKinds(p4) -- line: 331
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    local t2 = {}

    for _, v7 in t1.Kinds do
        if t1.GetWorld(v7) == p4 then
            table.insert(t2, v7)
        end
    end

    return t2
end

function t1.GetIndex(p5) -- line: 342
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy)
    return table.find(t1.GetKinds(t1.GetWorld(p5)), p5) or 1
end

t1.ByPlanet = false
t1.RobuxAhead = 1

function t1.GetOffer(p6, p7, p8) -- line: 363
    -- upvalues: PathConfig (copy), t1 (copy)
    local v8 = t1.GetWorld(p6)

    if (if typeof(p7) == "number" then p7 else 1) < v8 then
        return nil
    end

    if v8 < 2 or not t1.ByPlanet or not PathConfig.PlanetGate then
        return "Cash"
    end

    local v9 = PathConfig.GetPlanets(p7, p8)
    local v10 = t1.GetIndex(p6)

    if v10 <= v9 then
        return "Cash"
    end

    return if v10 <= v9 + t1.RobuxAhead then "Robux" else nil
end

function t1.GetShine(p9) -- line: 383
    -- upvalues: PetConfig (copy), t1 (copy), v1 (copy)
    local v11 = t1.Skins[p9]

    if v11 then
        return v11.Look.Colors
    end

    local v12 = t1.Trails[p9]

    if v12.Look then
        return v12.Look.Colors
    end

    local v13 = PetConfig.Rarities[v12.Rarity]

    if v13.Shine then
        return v13.Shine
    end

    local v14 = v12.Color2:Lerp(v12.Color, 0.5)

    return {
        v14,
        v12.Color,
        v12.Color:Lerp(v1, 0.55),
        v12.Color,
        v14
    }
end

function t1.GetColors(p10, p11, p12) -- line: 450
    -- upvalues: t1 (copy), v1 (copy)
    local v15 = t1.GetShine(p10)
    local v16 = #v15
    local t3 = {}

    for i = 0, 10 do
        local v17 = (i / 10 * t1.ShineSpan - (p11 or 0)) % 1 * v16
        local v18 = math.floor(v17)
        local v19 = v15[v18 % v16 + 1]:Lerp(v15[(v18 + 1) % v16 + 1], v17 - v18)

        if p12 and p12 > 0 then
            v19 = v19:Lerp(v1, p12)
        end

        t3[i + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 10, v19)
    end

    return ColorSequence.new(t3)
end

return t1

local function bind(signal, callback)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback); links[#links+1] = c; return c

local function character()
    local c = player.Character
    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local root = c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if h and h.Health > 0 and root then return h, root end
end
local function unload()
    if not running then return end
    running=false
    for k in pairs(enabled) do enabled[k]=false end
    for _,c in ipairs(links) do c:Disconnect() end
    if gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end
    if env.NoLimitPetUnload == unload then env.NoLimitPetUnload=nil end
end
env.NoLimitPetUnload=unload
local function make(class, parent, props)
    local o=Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k]=v end
    if o:IsA('GuiObject') and (not props or props.ZIndex==nil) then o.ZIndex=2 end
    o.Parent=parent; return o
end

end

    theme=name

    for _,a in ipairs(styled) do if a[1].Parent then a[1][a[2]]=palette[name][a[3]] end end
    if refreshNavigation then refreshNavigation() end
end

    style(o,'TextColor3',6); return o
end

    style(b,'BackgroundColor3',2); style(b,'TextColor3',6); round(b,8)
    bind(b.Activated,callback); return b
end

local visuals={background=true,animate=true}
local crownViews,backdrops={},{}
local crownAsset,animationAssets
local mediaIndex,mediaElapsed=1,0
local function decodeImage(encoded)
    local alphabet='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    local map={}; for i=1,#alphabet do map[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
    local result={}
    for i=1,#encoded,4 do
        local a,b,c,d=encoded:sub(i,i),encoded:sub(i+1,i+1),encoded:sub(i+2,i+2),encoded:sub(i+3,i+3)
        local n=(map[a] or 0)*262144+(map[b] or 0)*4096+(map[c] or 0)*64+(map[d] or 0)
        local x,y,z=math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,n%256
        result[#result+1]=d~='=' and string.char(x,y,z) or (c~='=' and string.char(x,y) or string.char(x))
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end
local function loadImage(name,page)
    local loader=type(getcustomasset)=='function' and getcustomasset or getsynasset
    assert(type(loader)=='function' and type(writefile)=='function','Image support needs writefile and getcustomasset')
    local path=page and mediaData.files[name][page] or mediaData.files[name]
    local encoded=page and mediaData[name][page] or mediaData[name]
    local exists=false
    if type(isfile)=='function' then local ok,v=pcall(isfile,path); exists=ok and v==true end
    if not exists then writefile(path,decodeImage(encoded)) end
    local uri=loader(path); assert(type(uri)=='string' and #uri>0,'Local image could not be loaded')
    return uri
end
local function updateMedia()
    local sheet=math.floor((mediaIndex-1)/mediaData.perPage)+1
    local i=(mediaIndex-1)%mediaData.perPage
    local offset=Vector2.new(i%mediaData.columns*mediaData.width,math.floor(i/mediaData.columns)*mediaData.height)
    for _,v in ipairs(backdrops) do
        if v.image.Parent then
            if animationAssets and not v.sheets then
                v.sheets={}
                for n,uri in ipairs(animationAssets) do
                    local image=n==1 and v.image or v.image:Clone()
                    image.Image=uri; image.Visible=false; image.Parent=v.host
                    v.sheets[n]=image
                end
            end
            local show=visuals.background and animationAssets~=nil
            if v.sheets then
                -- Each page keeps its own permanent texture. Only its crop/visibility changes.
                if v.active and v.active~=sheet then v.sheets[v.active].Visible=false end
                v.sheets[sheet].ImageRectOffset=offset
                v.sheets[sheet].Visible=show; v.active=sheet
            else v.image.Visible=false end
            v.veil.Visible=show
        end
    end
    for _,v in ipairs(crownViews) do
        v.image.Visible=crownAsset~=nil; v.fallback.Visible=crownAsset==nil
        if crownAsset then v.image.Image=crownAsset end
    end
end
local function attachCrown(parent,size)
    local image=make('ImageLabel',parent,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Visible=false,ZIndex=4})
    style(image,'ImageColor3',8)
    local fallback=make('TextLabel',parent,{Text='♛',TextSize=28,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),ZIndex=4})
    style(fallback,'TextColor3',8)
    crownViews[#crownViews+1]={image=image,fallback=fallback}
    return image,fallback
end
local function attachBackdrop(parent,radius)
    parent.ClipsDescendants=true
    local image=make('ImageLabel',parent,{Position=UDim2.fromScale(-.125,-.125),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1.25,1.25),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),ImageTransparency=0,
        ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(mediaData.width,mediaData.height),Visible=false,ZIndex=1})
    round(image,radius)
    local veil=make('Frame',parent,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=.93,BorderSizePixel=0,Visible=false,ZIndex=1})
    veil.BackgroundColor3=backgroundTint; tintTargets[#tintTargets+1]=veil; round(veil,radius)
    backdrops[#backdrops+1]={image=image,veil=veil,host=parent}
end
local function startMedia()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,value=pcall(loadImage,'crown')
        if not running then return end
        if ok then crownAsset=value; updateMedia() else warn('NoLimit crown: '..tostring(value)) end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,value=pcall(function()
            local sheets={}
            for i=1,#mediaData.astronaut do
                if not running then return nil end
                sheets[i]=loadImage('astronaut',i)
            end
            return sheets
        end)
        if not running then return end
        if ok and value then
            -- Finish texture loading before enabling frame changes.
            local loaded,err=pcall(function() game:GetService('ContentProvider'):PreloadAsync(value) end)
            if not running then return end
            if not loaded then warn('NoLimit background preload: '..tostring(err)); return end
            animationAssets=value; updateMedia()
        else warn('NoLimit astronaut: '..tostring(value)) end
    end)
end
bind(Run.RenderStepped,function(dt)
    if not visuals.animate or not visuals.background or not animationAssets then return end
    local visible=false; for _,v in ipairs(backdrops) do if v.host.Visible then visible=true; break end end
    if not visible then return end
    mediaElapsed+=math.min(dt,.25)
    local advanced=false
    while mediaElapsed>=(mediaData.durations[mediaIndex] or .05) do
        mediaElapsed-=mediaData.durations[mediaIndex] or .05
        mediaIndex=mediaIndex%mediaData.frames+1; advanced=true
    end
    if advanced then updateMedia() end
end)

    espControls[key]=function() b.Text=label..': '..(espOptions[key] and 'ON' or 'OFF') end
end

local function fire(name,...)
    local r=remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not r or not r:IsA('RemoteEvent') then error('RemoteEvent unavailable: '..name) end
    r:FireServer(...)
end
local function throttled(name,seconds,callback)
    if os.clock() < (cooldowns[name] or 0) then return false end
    cooldowns[name]=os.clock()+seconds; callback(); return true
end

local function drag(handle,target)
    local active,start,position
    bind(handle.InputBegan,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            active=i; start=i.Position; position=target.Position
        end
    end)
    bind(UIS.InputChanged,function(i)
        if active and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i==active) then
            local d=i.Position-start
            target.Position=UDim2.new(position.X.Scale,position.X.Offset+d.X,position.Y.Scale,position.Y.Offset+d.Y)
        end
    end)
    bind(UIS.InputEnded,function(i) if i==active then active=nil end end)
end

    if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    if waitingKey then
        waitingKey=false
        if i.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Escape and i.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then menuKey=i.KeyCode end
        keyButton.Text='Menu key: '..menuKey.Name; return
    end
    if processed then return end
    if i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.End and (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then unload()
    elseif i.KeyCode==menuKey then setMenuVisible(not menuShown) end
end)

local function filePath()
    local name=profileName.Text:gsub('[^%w_%-]',''):sub(1,32)
    if name=='' then error('Enter a profile name') end
    return 'NoLimitPet_'..name..'.json'
end
local function safeProfile(callback)
    local ok,err=pcall(callback); if not ok then notice(err) end
end

    notice('Profile saved. Automation switches are not restored automatically.')
end) end)

local function getPlot()
    local hub=workspace:FindFirstChild('Hub'); local plots=hub and hub:FindFirstChild('Plots')
    local id=player:GetAttribute('PlotId')
    return plots and id and plots:FindFirstChild('Plot'..tostring(id))
end
local treadmillCosts={0,5000,75000,300000,1000000,5000000,25000000,100000000,500000000,2000000000,
    2.5e13,7.5e14,1.3e17,2.9e18,7.7e19,5e21,3.2e23,5.7e24,1.4e26,2.5e27}
local function nextTreadmill(level,world)
    if type(level)~='number' or level%1~=0 or level<1 then return nil end
    local maximum=(tonumber(world) or 1)>=2 and 20 or 10
    if level>=maximum then return nil end
    return level+1,treadmillCosts[level+1]
end
local function upgradeStep()
    if os.clock()<rebirthPendingUntil then status('upgrade','Waiting for rebirth to settle'); return end
    local plot=getPlot()
    if not plot then status('upgrade','Waiting for your plot'); return end
    local level=plot:GetAttribute('TreadmillLevel')
    local nextLevel,cost=nextTreadmill(level,player:GetAttribute('BestWorld'))
    if not nextLevel then status('upgrade',type(level)=='number' and 'Maximum unlocked level reached' or 'Waiting for treadmill level'); return end
    local cash=tonumber(player:GetAttribute('Cash')) or 0
    if cash<cost then status('upgrade','Level '..nextLevel..' • need '..tostring(cost-cash)..' more cash'); return end
    throttled('upgrade'..tostring(level),3,function() fire('UpgradeTreadmill') end)
    status('upgrade','Requested level '..nextLevel..'; awaiting level update')
end
local markers={}
clearESP=function()
    for cage,record in pairs(markers) do record.tag:Destroy(); record.glow:Destroy(); markers[cage]=nil end
end
local function cageVisible(kind,selected,on)
    return on==true and selected[kind]==true and configs.CageConfig.Cages[kind]~=nil
end
local cageCache,cacheAt={},-10
local function espStep()
    if not enabled.esp then clearESP(); status('esp','OFF'); return end
    if os.clock()-cacheAt>2 then
        cageCache={}; cacheAt=os.clock()
        local folders={}
        local function addPaths(root)
            local paths=root and root:FindFirstChild('Paths')
            if paths then for _,path in ipairs(paths:GetChildren()) do
                local cages=path:FindFirstChild('Cages'); if cages then folders[#folders+1]=cages end
            end end
        end
        addPaths(workspace); addPaths(workspace:FindFirstChild('World2'))
        for _,folder in ipairs(folders) do for _,o in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if o:IsA('Model') and o.Parent and o.Parent.Name=='Cages'
                and type(o:GetAttribute('Path'))=='number' and o:FindFirstChild('Root')
                and o.Root:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt') then
                cageCache[#cageCache+1]=o
            end
        end end
    end
    local _,root=character(); local seen={}; local count=0
    for _,cage in ipairs(cageCache) do
        local kind=cage:GetAttribute('Kind'); local part=cage:FindFirstChild('Root')
        if cage:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and cage.Parent.Name=='Cages' and part and part:IsA('BasePart')
            and part:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt') and cageVisible(kind,chosen,enabled.esp) then
            count+=1; seen[cage]=true
            local def=configs.CageConfig.Cages[kind]
            local color=def.Color or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
            local record=markers[cage]
            if not record then
                local glow=make('Highlight',gui,{Adornee=cage,DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
                    FillTransparency=.7,OutlineTransparency=.05})
                local tag=make('BillboardGui',gui,{Adornee=part,AlwaysOnTop=true,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,44),StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,4,0)})
                local label=make('TextLabel',tag,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=.25,
                    BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,10,14),TextSize=13,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextStrokeTransparency=.6,TextWrapped=true})
                round(label,8)
                record={glow=glow,tag=tag,label=label}; markers[cage]=record
            end
            record.glow.FillColor=color; record.glow.OutlineColor=color; record.glow.Enabled=count<=24
            local lines={}
            if espOptions.names then lines[#lines+1]=def.Name or (kind..' Cage') end
            if espOptions.distance and root then lines[#lines+1]=math.floor((part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude)..' studs' end
            record.label.Text=table.concat(lines,' • '); record.label.TextColor3=color
            record.tag.Enabled=#lines>0
        end
    end
    for cage,record in pairs(markers) do if not seen[cage] then
        record.tag:Destroy(); record.glow:Destroy(); markers[cage]=nil
    end end
    status('esp',count..' matching loaded cages')
    movementStatus.Text='Cage ESP • '..count..' shown'
end
local function rewardStep()
    if enabled.daily then
        if player:GetAttribute('DailyReady')==true then
            throttled('daily',4,function() fire('ClaimDaily') end); status('daily','Claim requested; waiting for server')
        else status('daily','Waiting for next daily reward') end
    end
    if enabled.time then
        local c=configs.TimeRewardConfig
        if not c then status('time','TimeRewardConfig unavailable'); return end
        local claimed={}; for n in tostring(player:GetAttribute('TimeClaimed') or ''):gmatch('%d+') do claimed[tonumber(n)]=true end
        local base,since=player:GetAttribute('PlayBase'),player:GetAttribute('PlaySince')
        if type(base)~='number' or type(since)~='number' then status('time','Waiting for playtime data'); return end
        local seconds=base+math.max(0,workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-since)
        local nextSeconds; local due={}; local unclaimed=0
        for i in ipairs(c.Rewards) do
            local reward=c.GetReward(i,player:GetAttribute('TimeFirstDay')==true,player:GetAttribute('TimePassOpen')==true,player:GetAttribute('TimeSet'))
            if not claimed[i] and reward then
                unclaimed+=1
                local remaining=reward.Minutes*60-seconds
                if remaining<=0 then due[#due+1]=i
                elseif not nextSeconds or remaining<nextSeconds then nextSeconds=remaining end
            end
        end
        if #due>0 then
            throttled('timeBatch',1,function()
                for _,i in ipairs(due) do
                    if not running or not enabled.time then break end
                    -- Queue all ready slots in this cycle, without sleeps between requests.
                    fire('ClaimTimeReward',i)
                end
            end)
            status('time','Claiming all '..#due..' ready rewards together; awaiting confirmation')
        elseif unclaimed==0 then status('time','All time rewards claimed')
        else status('time','Next reward in '..math.ceil(nextSeconds or 0)..'s') end
    end
end
local function indexStep()
    local folder=player:FindFirstChild('Index'); local count=0
    if folder then for _,e in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if e:GetAttribute('Claimed')~=true then count+=1 end end end
    if count>0 then throttled('index',5,function() fire('ClaimAllIndexRewards') end) end
    status('index',count>0 and (count..' unclaimed discoveries; claim requested') or 'No unclaimed pet entries')
end
local function rebirthStep()
    local c=configs.RebirthConfig; if not c then status('rebirth','RebirthConfig unavailable'); return end
    local n=c.Count(player)+1; local cost=c.GetCost(n,tonumber(player:GetAttribute('BestWorld')) or 1)
    local biome=c.GetBiome(n)
    if not cost then status('rebirth','No rebirth currently unlocked'); return end
    if biome and (tonumber(player:GetAttribute('DailyBiome')) or 1)<biome then status('rebirth','Requires biome '..biome); return end
    if (player:GetAttribute('Cash') or 0)<cost then status('rebirth','Saving cash for next rebirth'); return end
    if player:GetAttribute('CarryingCage')~=nil then status('rebirth','Waiting until cage is delivered'); return end
    throttled('rebirth',8,function() fire('Rebirth'); rebirthPendingUntil=os.clock()+6 end)
    status('rebirth','Rebirth requested; waiting for server')
end
local function trailStep()
    if os.clock()<rebirthPendingUntil then status('trail','Waiting for rebirth to finish'); return end
    local c=configs.TrailConfig; if not c then status('trail','TrailConfig unavailable'); return end
    local owned=player:FindFirstChild('Trails'); local cash=player:GetAttribute('Cash') or 0
    local bestOwned,bestBuy,ownedBoost,buyBoost=nil,nil,-1,-1
    for id,t in pairs(c.Trails) do
        local boost=tonumber(t.Treadmill) or 0
        if owned and owned:FindFirstChild(id) and boost>ownedBoost then bestOwned=id; ownedBoost=boost end
        if (not owned or not owned:FindFirstChild(id)) and type(t.Price)=='number' and t.Price<=cash
            and c.GetOffer(id,tonumber(player:GetAttribute('BestWorld')) or 1,tonumber(player:GetAttribute('DailyBiome')))=='Cash'
            and boost>buyBoost then bestBuy=id; buyBoost=boost end
    end
    if bestBuy and buyBoost>ownedBoost then
        throttled('trailBuy',5,function() fire('BuyTrail',bestBuy) end); status('trail','Purchase requested: '..bestBuy)
    else status('trail','Best affordable trail already owned') end
    if bestOwned and player:GetAttribute('Trail')~=bestOwned then throttled('trailEquip',3,function() fire('EquipTrail',bestOwned) end) end
end
local function worker(k,callback)
    local ok,err=pcall(callback)
    if not ok and running then status(k,'Error: '..tostring(err):sub(1,140)); warn('NoLimit '..k..': '..tostring(err)) end
end
task.spawn(function()
    if not running then return end
    local c=configs.CageConfig; local sorted={}
    if c then for id,value in pairs(c.Cages) do sorted[#sorted+1]={id,value.Order or 0} end end
    table.sort(sorted,function(a,b) return a[2]<b[2] end)
    for _,entry in ipairs(sorted) do
        local id=entry[1]; local b
        b=button(rarityList,'',function() chosen[id]=not chosen[id] end)
        local last
        rarityRefreshers[#rarityRefreshers+1]=function()
            local value=chosen[id]==true
            if value~=last then b.Text=(value and '✓  ' or '')..id; last=value end
        end
        rarityRefreshers[#rarityRefreshers]()
    end
    if not c then note(espPage,'CageConfig failed to load. Check the Overview or F9.') end
    notice('Ready. Choose rarities under Cage ESP; all switches begin OFF.')
end)
local elapsed,frames=0,0
bind(Run.RenderStepped,function(dt)
    elapsed+=dt; frames+=1
    if elapsed<.5 then return end
    if window.Visible and espPage.Visible then for _,refresh in ipairs(rarityRefreshers) do refresh() end end
    local fps=math.floor(frames/elapsed+.5); frames=0; elapsed=0
    local ping='—'
    pcall(function() ping=game:GetService('Stats').Network.ServerStatsItem['Data Ping']:GetValueString() end)
    fpsText.Text='FPS    '..fps..'\nPING  '..ping
    local count=0; for _,on in pairs(enabled) do if on then count+=1 end end
    stats.Text='Active: '..count..' / 8\nCash: '..tostring(player:GetAttribute('Cash') or 0)..'   Speed: '..tostring(player:GetAttribute('Speed') or 0)..'\nPlot: '..tostring(player:GetAttribute('PlotId') or 'waiting')
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then scale.Scale=math.clamp(math.min((cam.ViewportSize.X-30)/760,(cam.ViewportSize.Y-30)/560),.3,1) end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        if enabled.esp then worker('esp',espStep) end
        task.wait(.6)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        worker('time',rewardStep)
        if enabled.index then worker('index',indexStep) end
        if enabled.rebirth then worker('rebirth',rebirthStep) end
        if enabled.trail then worker('trail',trailStep) end
        if enabled.upgrade then worker('upgrade',upgradeStep) end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

    end
end)

local lastIdleInput=-100
local function idlePulse()
    if not running or not enabled.afk or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or os.clock()-lastIdleInput<45 then return end
    lastIdleInput=os.clock()
    local ok=pcall(function()
        local input=game:GetService('VirtualInputManager')
        input:SendKeyEvent(true,Enum.KeyCode.F15,false,game)
        input:SendKeyEvent(false,Enum.KeyCode.F15,false,game)
    end)
    if not ok then
        ok=pcall(function() local v=game:GetService('VirtualUser'); v:CaptureController(); v:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0,0)) end)
    end
    status('afk',ok and 'Idle input sent; game AFK behavior still applies' or 'Input API unavailable in this executor')
end
bind(player.Idled,function() idlePulse() end)
task.spawn(function() while running do idlePulse(); task.wait(10) end end)
